items.description:
Silver Star Function Hiring supplies event hire equipment for weddings and other functions across Gauteng, delivering to the client's venue. Its range covers tables and chairs, furniture, artificial plants, carpets and stanchions, outdoor heating, spit and braai equipment, cutlery, underplates and crockery, decor items including backdrops, linen, staging and lighting, and catering equipment. The company organises its offering into these hire categories so clients can build up an order for an event from a single supplier.

Beyond equipment hire, it offers access to event stylists who can meet with clients to discuss the details of an event and help plan what is needed, from table settings to stage and lighting setups, so that each function is put together to suit the client's own requirements and venue.

Silverton Radiators has been in the engine cooling business for decades and has operated as the Silverton Radiators dealer for the Pretoria East area for more than 30 years. The business specialises in engine cooling systems, offering specialist advice, radiator and intercooler re-coring or refurbishment, sales of quality replacement parts, and custom-made parts. Its workshop also handles cooling system troubleshooting, servicing and repairs, along with professional flushing of cooling systems and specialised testing of cooling system components.

The company describes its approach as helping customers get back on the road with the least possible inconvenience and at the best possible price, built around values of mutual respect, personal and professional integrity, service excellence, quality workmanship, and reliability and dependability.

SimCura Business Systems is a partner for SAP Business One in South Africa, delivering cloud ERP implementation, consulting and support aimed at growing small and medium-sized businesses. Its offering includes SAP Business One cloud solutions, which the company describes as customisable, scalable and affordable, as well as SAP Business One running on SAP HANA, positioned for real-time simulation and planning. SimCura also offers mobile solutions intended to help employees, customers and partners work more efficiently, and partners with other technology vendors to add functionality and industry-specific solutions.

Beyond software, it provides IT hardware acquisition through flexible rental and procurement arrangements with related value-added services. Its services span pre-sales support, project management, implementation and training for clients adopting SAP Business One.

Simplex Holdings Group is a multi-disciplinary consulting firm operating predominantly in Sub-Saharan Africa, covering labour law, immigration, criminal and forensic investigations, insurance assessments, compliance, fraud awareness presentations, general legal consulting, and fraud risk review and assessment workshops. Rather than keeping all expertise in-house, its business model is to draw on an extensive network of professionals and associates, resourcing up with specialists as each client assignment requires. The firm describes itself as a boutique practice with a national infrastructure, offering consulting strategy, efficiency consulting and training alongside commercially minded, practical service solutions, including tailor-made resourcing and recruiting support. Fees are described as flexible and negotiable depending on the scope of work.

Based in Eldoraigne, Centurion, the firm works across labour, insurance, immigration, fraud and risk management, and legal consulting matters.

Sinergy Signs produces signage and advertising materials for businesses in Gauteng, offering graphic design, manufacturing, installation and maintenance as part of its service. Its printing division covers large-format digital printing, silkscreen printing, vinyl stickers, textile printing and banners, while its outdoor media range includes billboards, pylons, cut-out letters and lightboxes, shopfront signage, safety and directional signage, and correx boards and A-frames. For indoor spaces, the company supplies reception and wall signs, directional signage, wallpaper, and sandblasting or frosting on glass. It also produces signage for parkades, including freestanding and directional signs, pillar and boom advertisements, and tariff-change signage, plus vehicle branding such as wraps, vinyl lettering and vehicle magnetics.

On the promotional side, Sinergy Signs supplies banners, flags, gazebos, correx and agent boards, clip-on frames, and bulk branded items such as t-shirts, caps, bags and flyers.

SMK Projects Pools & Renovations is a construction and renovation contractor working across Pretoria, Mayville, Centurion and the wider Gauteng area, covering new swimming pools and home improvement projects. Its pool work includes custom pool construction, pool renovations, marbelite restoration, waterproofing, pump installation and pool repairs.

On the building side, it takes on new builds, house extensions, boundary walls and structural improvements, aiming for solid foundations, clean finishes and professional project management. The company also offers paving and tiling, including driveway and patio paving along with bathroom, kitchen and interior floor tiling, as well as plumbing services such as leak repairs, pipe installation, geyser support and drainage work. Its painting service covers interior and exterior painting, damp preparation and wall repairs, while its plastering and ceiling work includes ceiling installation, skimming, plaster repairs, cornices and bulkheads.

Soapbox Promo & Gifts supplies promotional clothing and corporate gifts from its base in Brummeria, Pretoria, with a product range spanning items such as clocks, folders, pens, calculators, shirts, caps and other garments, along with outdoor products. Branding of these items is handled in-house, including its own embroidery service, so clients can have logos and other branding applied by the company directly. Soapbox also operates online order portals through which clients can browse its catalogues and place orders.

Alongside supplying promotional products directly to businesses, the company has made franchises available in a number of areas around South Africa, offering franchisees access to its product range, pricing and existing business systems as part of a wider Soapbox network.

SOAR Solutions is based in Tijger Valley and positions itself as a co-ordinator of existing specialist businesses working on social, economic and environmental challenges across Africa. Rather than carrying out every project alone, the company brings specialist partners together through joint ventures or focused programmes aimed at a common outcome, on the basis that an intervention in one area can have a positive effect on others. Its focus is on community-based eco-systems, and its projects use the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals as guidelines, with a focus on basic needs, community and transformation.

The organisation structures its work around founding partners, current projects and associates, connecting specialist organisations rather than delivering all services directly itself.

Soin Africa is an online retailer of professional audio equipment, operating from The Willows, Pretoria. Its online shop sells full-range speakers, subwoofers, loose speakers and speaker sets, along with replacement parts and FatalPro drivers for repairing or rebuilding existing speaker systems. Products are sold under brand names including Nexus, X Audio and FatalPro, covering a range of speaker models aimed at sound and events use. The site also lists dealers who stock its products, and presents its catalogue by brand and by product category, so customers can browse models and add items to an order.

Soin Africa's storefront is built on the PrestaShop platform, and its online catalogue is the main way customers find and buy its products.

Sonfin Pty Ltd is an independent company based in Kloofsig, Centurion, that specialises in structuring green power solutions on behalf of its customers. Rather than offering one fixed package, the company streamlines the sourcing of green power with an offering tailored to each customer's individual needs, and says it has more than 15 years of experience in the field. Sonfin positions itself to help customers capitalise on solar energy, working with both agricultural and commercial clients.

The company describes its staff as practising absolute confidentiality, honesty and integrity when handling client matters, and it invites prospective customers to make contact to discuss a professional approach to their solar energy needs.

The South African Mint Company is a wholly owned subsidiary of the South African Reserve Bank. It designs and produces circulation coins as well as numismatic collector coins and bullion products, selling through authorised dealers. Its catalogue is organised by year, with collectable coin ranges running from 2020 through to its current 2026 range. Among its recent releases is the African Range, which the Mint describes as its first high-relief coin range, and the Odyssey of the Sky, a seven-coin series whose second release is the 2026 Martial Eagle.

The company publishes product mintage figures for its collectable ranges, and also runs a museum and provides brochures and an order form for South African circulation coins.

Space Technology supplies audio-visual, multimedia, electrical, satellite, security and television equipment, and operates from Kloofsig in Centurion. Its product range spans categories such as audio and visual equipment, multimedia gear, electrical products, satellite and VSAT hardware, security equipment and television products, and it allows businesses to register as trade customers. Among its stock are mounting and networking accessories for satellite internet systems, WiFi wall brackets in hot-dip and electro-galvanised finishes, and a solar power starter kit for outdoor networking installations. The company also supplies ICASA-approved signal repeaters and boosters, along with fibre amplifiers designed for CATV and PON fibre network applications.

Alongside its trade supply business, Space Technology operates a number of Xpress Kiosks.

SPM (Pty) Ltd specialises in managing sectional title schemes and homeowners associations across Gauteng from its base in Magalieskruin. The company says it currently manages around 3,500 sectional title units and 500 full title properties, along with a number of rental units, with each complex assigned to a member of its team. Its services cover sectional title and full title management alongside administrative, secretarial and advisory support for property owners, trustees and directors. The company states that it is registered with the statutory and regulatory authorities relevant to scheme management in South Africa.

SPM positions its combination of long years of experience and personal attention as the basis for its work with homeowners associations and sectional title schemes in the region.

SPROUT is an enterprise development company in Irene offering integrated business support to small businesses across South Africa. Its stated mission is to help businesses not just survive their early years but grow and thrive, drawing on its team's experience in enterprise development to address the challenges South African businesses often face. The company's coaching service is aimed at helping small businesses overcome challenges, develop strategies and reach their potential, with coaches providing support tailored to each business.

On the funding side, SPROUT helps businesses access a range of finance options, including loans, grants and equity investments. The company also refers to purchase order funding and a School of Export, pointing to support that extends into helping businesses take on larger orders and export work.

Square Edge Construction Projects is a construction company based in Boschkop, Pretoria, working across residential developments, commercial projects, renovations and alterations. The company describes its approach as hands-on, aiming to deliver projects on time, within budget and to a consistent standard of quality across different types and sizes of construction work. Its portfolio of completed work includes the Saffron Lifestyle and Makarios Residential Estate developments, both listed under residential projects, as well as a commercial project for Care and Mobility and work on the Vivini Residential Estate.

Square Edge presents these completed jobs as examples of its range, from residential estate construction through to smaller renovation and alteration projects for existing buildings.

Staalboer Aqua manufactures and installs galvanised steel water tanks, water tank stands and guard towers from its base in Kameeldrift East, with installation and delivery offered across Africa. Its steel panel reservoirs are available in galvanised or ZincAL finishes across a wide range of sizes for bulk water storage, while its tank stands and guard towers are built for conditions ranging from rural farms to high-security sites. The designs are modular to suit different budgets, and the structures are engineered to withstand high wind speeds.

The company, established in 2003, describes itself as a proudly South African manufacturer and registered international exporter, offering a ten-year workmanship warranty and a pro-rata warranty against sun damage to tank liners. Its products are ISO compliant, with engineering certification available on request for an additional charge.

StatAdmin is a company secretarial and statutory administrative services provider based in Woodhill Golf Estate, Garsfontein. The business positions itself as a proactive supplier in this field, handling company secretarial and compliance administration so that clients do not have to manage it themselves in-house.

Its team has extensive experience in company secretarial work, drawing on backgrounds that include managing a secretarial department at one of the large audit firms and prior experience at the office of the Registrar of Companies, with more than 40 years of combined experience among the team. StatAdmin describes its client services approach and industry focus as the basis for meeting and exceeding client requirements and expectations in statutory administration work.

STEELOREX manufactures commercial kitchen and foodservice equipment from its base in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, describing itself as a leading South African manufacturer in this category. Its product range includes ice cream machines, from single to triple-flavour models, and gas combo grillers that combine several cooking functions in a single unit, alongside foodservice, workstation, mobile kitchen, refrigeration and extraction equipment lines. Workstation products include tables, counters, sinks, trolleys, risers, jockeys and wall shelves, while its mobile range covers mobile kitchens and mobile chillers.

Customers can choose in-store collection or delivery, and the company offers a seven-day return policy, comprehensive product warranties, and spares, repairs and maintenance support. STEELOREX also ships its equipment nationwide, supplying hospitality and foodservice businesses beyond the Centurion area.

Stodels is a garden centre in Menlo Park offering a wide range of plants and gardening products. Its plant range spans categories such as indoor and office plants, fruit trees, roses, succulents and cacti, ferns, palms, conifers, grasses, shrubs, climbers and seedlings, with plants also grouped by purpose, including hedging, indigenous planting, kitchen gardening, bonsai and plants that attract bees and wildlife, and by growing environment, from sunny and waterwise gardens to shaded and coastal conditions. Alongside plants, the centre stocks pots and planters in terracotta, ceramic, wood and plastic, plant care products such as irrigation equipment, fertiliser, pest control and compost, garden tools, and outdoor items including water features, garden furniture and ornaments.

Stodels also runs a Garden Club, which sends members seasonal gardening tips and offers.

Stoep Stories is a family-friendly pub and restaurant in Magalieskruin, offering both dine-in and takeout service. The venue has outdoor seating and keeps late-night food service running, with a menu that includes cocktails and signature dishes such as eishbein. It accepts reservations and occasionally hosts live music, aiming for a casual, cosy atmosphere suited to groups and families, with high chairs and a kids' menu available for younger diners. The bar serves beer, wine, hard liquor and cocktails alongside food, and the menu includes small plates as well as full meals. Payment options include credit and debit cards and NFC mobile payments, and the venue lists wheelchair accessible seating, restroom and parking facilities.

The combination of a casual pub setting, a full food menu and outdoor seating makes it a neighbourhood spot for both everyday meals and later-evening dining.

Storage Management Systems is a turnkey intralogistics solutions provider based in Irene, with around 30 years of experience in warehousing and automation. The company focuses on optimising the flow of materials, goods, stock and parts through a distribution centre or warehouse, offering static and automated storage and material handling solutions. Its product range includes the Omni Mole, an automated pallet storage and retrieval system, and the Pallet Mole, a semi-automated pallet storage system. The company also offers high-capacity sortation equipment, including the Vanriet shoe sorter, along with software and control systems to run these installations.

Storage Management Systems positions itself as a specialist in high-density automated pallet storage and retrieval, aiming to help distribution centres and warehouses increase efficiency and competitiveness through integrated, automated logistics.

STRATLAW is a boutique legal advisory firm in Lynnwood Ridge, Pretoria, offering tailor-made legal solutions rather than standard packages. Its practice areas include contract law, tax, shareholder relations, labour law, corporate governance, estate planning and B-BBEE compliance. The firm positions its role as helping clients manage legal risk and navigate legislative requirements that could otherwise disrupt their business.

For new entrepreneurs, STRATLAW offers a start-up package covering company registration, drafting of a Memorandum of Incorporation, company secretarial matters such as meetings and minutes, and assistance with B-BBEE certification and verification. The firm also drafts contracts tailored to a client's circumstances rather than working only on an ad hoc basis, and offers its services on a fixed-term basis so clients can choose which services they receive and get a quote built around those choices.

Stratus Business Consultants, based in Lynnwood, Pretoria, works with a network of industry experts to assist businesses with requirements ranging from preparing an annual report through to a corporate restructure. Its listed areas of assistance include helping businesses achieve their BEE ownership objectives, supporting insolvency and liquidation restructuring processes, and working on strategies intended to reduce balance sheet stress, generate cash and reduce costs, and increase profitability. The firm presents itself as a resource for businesses of different sizes, drawing on its network of specialists rather than relying on a single adviser for every type of financial or ownership-restructuring matter a client might face.

Clients can get in touch through the firm's contact page to discuss their requirements.

Suntech Consulting is an ICT solutions provider based in Eco Park Estate, Centurion, established in 2015 and rated BBBEE Level 1 with 100% black ownership. The company is led by IT professionals with a combined 35 years of industry experience, and employs specialists across ERP implementation and support, project management, software development, software testing, system integration, data analytics and cloud services. Its consultants work to determine a client's specific needs and improve business efficiency, while its developers focus on delivering high-quality software solutions. Suntech's system integrators have experience connecting complex and older systems with current software, and the company works closely with original equipment manufacturer partners to keep its teams current on industry developments.

The business describes its approach as acting quickly and keeping procedures as simple as possible for clients working through digital transformation projects.

Supreme Worx is a mechanical and electrical engineering design company based in Booysens, Pretoria, offering mechanical product design, electrical product design and component engineering services to clients both locally and internationally. The company says it applies the same focus on quality across projects regardless of their size, scale or sector, offering customised engineering services built around the specific requirements of each project rather than a standard package. Its work draws on durable, high-quality materials, with advisors available to provide guidance through a project's lifecycle.

Alongside its contract engineering and design work, Supreme Worx has developed its own product lines, including the Supreme Pontoon and the Supreme Tower, which form part of its own range of engineered products.

Syntech is a technology products distributor that sources and distributes brands from around the world, working with a network of resellers to bring these products to the South African market from its site in Samrand Business Park, Kosmosdal. Its catalogue spans appliance categories such as air purifiers, fans, heaters, humidifiers and dehumidifiers, along with cleaning appliances including cordless and robot vacuums, among them the Xiaomi Robot Vacuum Mop range. The company also distributes kitchen appliances, pet technology products, and bags, luggage and travel accessories such as backpacks and screen protectors, along with spare parts for the ranges it carries.

Syntech's stated values include appreciation of excellence, honourable candour, a thirst for learning and a commitment to innovation.

Talisman Hire Klerksoord (Rosslyn) is a branch of the Talisman Hire equipment rental group, located at the corner of Rosslyn Road and Willem Cruywagen Avenue in Klerksoord. The branch hires out a broad range of equipment, including compressors, drilling equipment, heating and drying equipment, power tools, and surface preparation and finishing equipment. Its range also covers battery-driven equipment, concrete equipment, forestry equipment, lighting equipment, and personal protective and safety equipment, along with surveying and cleaning equipment. Customers can also buy consumables and spares for the equipment.

As part of the wider Talisman Hire network, the branch offers access to this full equipment range for construction, maintenance and other site-based work in the surrounding area.

Tegra is a systems integration partner based in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, specialising in API management, API security, secure managed file transfer and network security for businesses across Southern Africa. The company has more than 20 years of experience integrating trusted technologies from established software providers to address integration and security challenges for client organisations. Its work covers automating business-to-business processes, securing data that is critical to a client's operations, and managing APIs across hybrid environments that mix on-site and cloud systems.

Tegra describes its focus as providing reliable, scalable and affordable integration across API ecosystems, partner networks and wider digital infrastructure, helping organisations stay secure and connected as they adapt to changing operational and compliance requirements across a range of industries.

Terravua is a specialist geotextile and civil engineering company based in Garsfontein, Pretoria, focused on geotextile dewatering tubes, sludge dewatering and capping, coastal protection and erosion control. Through partnerships with international geosynthetic suppliers and local partners, it supplies geotextile solutions used to manage water, waste, sludge and vulnerable infrastructure. Its applications include municipal wastewater treatment works, mining tailings, slimes dams, coal fines and process water, agricultural waste such as manure sludge and abattoir waste, and dredged material from pond clean-out projects, as well as shoreline protection against coastal erosion.

Terravua offers full project support for these applications, from site assessment and technical design through to product supply, installation support and complete project execution.

The At Company is a marketing and brand agency based in Montana Park, Pretoria, working on corporate and brand identity for client businesses. Its corporate and brand identity service covers design along with company culture, values and internal and external communications, aiming to produce a consistent identity across an organisation. The company also offers interior design and decorating for office spaces, working with businesses that are moving premises or renovating an existing workspace, on the basis that office layout and style affect employee comfort and productivity.

Alongside this, it organises functions and events intended to show a client's identity to its audience, and produces marketing materials and gifts that represent a business to potential clients.

The Baron Kyalami is a branch of The Baron Group, which has been trading since 1993 and describes itself as a professional entertainment group managed by a team of professionals. The branch operates from Kyalami Corner Shopping Centre on Main Road in Kyalami, Midrand, and forms part of a wider network of Baron branches that includes Lynnwood, Leaping Frog, Umhlanga, Woodmead, Irene and Sandton. The Kyalami branch offers the group's Baron menu alongside a date night menu, drinks menu, office menu, platter menu and a year-end function menu, giving customers different menu formats depending on the occasion, from a casual meal to a booked office lunch or year-end function.

The Success Academy operates office parks in Centurion and Pretoria, renting out office suites ranging from about 65 square metres up to 1,500 square metres. Its buildings are designed with a classical look intended to project an image of quality for tenant businesses, and the parks are run with round-the-clock biometric access control and on-site security officers. Beyond the office space itself, the company handles the practical side of running an office park, including maintenance, building security, and backup water and electricity supply, so that tenant businesses can focus on their own operations.

The Success Academy also runs a rewards programme for tenants, maintains a business directory, hosts events through the year, and publishes its own TSA Magazine, aimed at building a working business community across its office parks.

Three38 is a business automation and consulting firm based in Midstream Estate, Olifantsfontein, working with businesses that want to simplify their operations, improve the customer experience they offer, and drive growth. The company positions itself as a partner for business automation and strategic oversight, aiming to help businesses become leaner, more compliant and more competitive. Its core offering is a strategy session with clients, intended to surface specific gaps in how a business currently operates and turn those insights into concrete action that eliminates operational waste.

Three38 frames its role as taking responsibility for the parts of running a business that owners might otherwise overlook, working alongside a business's existing team so that day-to-day operations run more effectively.

Tileba Pharmacy is a dispensing pharmacy in Nina Park Square Shopping Centre, operating as part of the Arrie Nel Pharmacy Group. Alongside its pharmacy and dispensary, the store runs a family clinic with its own operating hours, offering clinic services on Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays and Fridays, and on the first and last Saturday of each month, while remaining closed on Sundays and public holidays for clinic appointments. The pharmacy itself keeps longer trading hours across the week, including Saturday and Sunday retail hours, to support both prescription dispensing and general pharmacy shopping.

As part of the wider Arrie Nel group, the branch also has access to the group's broader services, including warehousing support, within a shopping centre setting.

Tong-Mongalo Corporate Services, known as TMCS, is a corporate and commercial law consultancy in Amberfield Glen, Centurion, that describes itself as 100% black-owned and 50% female-owned and managed. The firm began its services business in October 2004 and focuses on legal consulting for business and non-profit organisations. Its specialities include contract management, covering policy development, contract analysis and advice on contract-related issues, as well as corporate and commercial law and corporate governance consulting, which extends to board and management training and evaluation.

TMCS positions its approach around understanding each client's needs individually and customising its services and solutions accordingly, rather than applying a single standard legal package across different clients.

Torque Africa Group is a specialist drilling contractor based in Donkerhoek, established in 2014 to provide drilling services for water, mining, and oil and gas exploration across Southern Africa and beyond. Its service range covers residential water wells, mineral and gas exploration, downhole camera inspections, construction and piling, mining and de-watering, and environmental and geotechnical drilling, as well as renewable energy projects. The company says it prioritises ongoing investment in research and development, bringing newer drilling technology and equipment into its operations to improve project outcomes.

Its stated aim is to become a leading drilling firm in the industry, built on a commitment to safety across its operations, reliable project delivery, and close working relationships with its clients.

Tree Felling Centurion provides tree felling and removal services across Centurion, including stump removal and palm tree removal, along with tree trimming and pruning. The company also offers an emergency tree removal service for storm damage and other hazardous trees that need urgent attention. Its tree felling and removal work, referred to locally as boomsloping, is carried out by a fully insured team of qualified tree specialists.

Customers can request a free quotation, which the company says it aims to send back within a couple of hours of a call. The business positions its rates as competitive while maintaining the same standard of work across both routine tree care and emergency call-outs.

Tshuketana Attorneys Inc is a Pretoria-based law firm founded in 2016, working across civil litigation, criminal law, family law, personal injury and medical negligence claims, and commercial and corporate law. The firm says it aims to resolve disputes efficiently and ethically, pursuing litigation only when it is necessary and in a client's best interest.

Within civil litigation, it represents clients in complex disputes through strategic negotiation as well as court action where needed, while its family law work covers divorce, custody and related family legal support. Its criminal law practice covers defence in criminal cases and unlawful detention matters, and its commercial and corporate law service includes drafting contracts, resolving commercial disputes, and handling insolvency and business legal compliance matters.

Tshwane Trust Co. (Pty) Ltd specialises in the administration of insolvent estates and has been in existence for more than 19 years, making it one of the longer-established insolvency practices in South Africa. Its work covers the administration of insolvent estates for companies, close corporations, trusts and individuals, as well as company and close corporation liquidations, curatorships nominated by the National Director of Public Prosecutions, and receiverships nominated by the South African Revenue Service. The firm has experience trading companies in liquidation as going concerns, with the stated aim of saving jobs where possible, and implements schemes of arrangement under section 155 of the Companies Act.

Tshwane Trust Co. became a Level 2 broad-based BEE contributor in March 2019, and its vision is to deliver a professional and efficient service with integrity, independence and honesty.

Tuff Tint, based in Constantia Park, Pretoria, focuses on precautionary automotive security solutions and aftermarket accessories for vehicles. Its core offering addresses smash-and-grab crime, which the company describes as one of the most common and startling forms of crime, with measures designed to safeguard drivers and their loved ones. Its accessories are tailored to each customer's individual requirements and budget rather than sold as a single standard package.

Beyond security add-ons, Tuff Tint runs an accessories and fitment shop, a gallery of pictures and videos, and sells its own merchandise, including clothing and miscellaneous branded items. The company says it believes quality comes first, with quantity following.

Tugela Financial Services is a licensed Financial Services Provider operating from Hazeldean Office Park, Pretoria, founded in 2015 and drawing on more than a decade of experience in the insurance industry. The company says its focus is on helping families earn more income and become debt free, by insuring business and personal assets against unforeseen circumstances and by teaching people how money works so they can work toward financial independence. As part of its approach, Tugela aims to give clients multiple options so that their risk can be covered in full rather than only in part.

The company publishes its regulatory documents, including its FSB licence annexures and code of conduct, as part of operating as a licensed provider.

Twenty2Twenty Consulting is an employee benefits and investment consultancy based in Die Hoewes, Centurion, working mainly with small to medium-sized companies as a licensed financial services provider. The firm advises employers on group risk assurance and retirement fund benefits, and designs solutions in this area rather than applying a standard package across clients. One of its core offerings is a fund investigation, a report covering a company's current retirement fund benefits, a cost analysis of what the company is paying, a comparison against industry trends, and a funding ratio analysis of the fund.

The consultancy positions this review as a way for employers to understand what they are currently paying for and how their fund benefits compare with the wider market, rather than continuing with an existing arrangement without checking it.

Ujala Consulting is a marketing, advertising and branding agency based in Midstream Estate, working on what it calls brand experience projects for clients. Its brand services cover strategy and brand positioning, branding and brand activations, design, content development, scriptwriting, videography, photography and art direction, along with video production and editing, animation and 3D renders, point-of-sale items, and corporate identity development ranging from logos through to brand guidelines. The agency also organises campaigns, events and corporate gifting as part of building a client's brand.

On the marketing and advertising side, Ujala offers traditional channels such as print media, radio, television and campaigns across the line, alongside non-traditional services including lead generation, social media, SEO, CRM and email marketing, and conversion rate optimisation.

items.reason: Research found no usable business content: the listing's website pages (/about, /about-us, /services) returned only a 'link doesn't appear to open any page' placeholder, the homepage timed out during crawling, and the search results returned were unrelated Google Play Store links. Nothing business-specific was captured, so the current one-liner is kept until a deeper pass.

WRONG-BUSINESS MATCH in research: the real site (tech-tech.co.za) timed out, and the fallback search pulled in an unrelated consumer electronics retailer (tech.co.za) and a tech news site (techcentral.co.za). None of the fetched text describes Tech-Tech's IT consulting and support services, so nothing can be sourced. Needs a direct re-check of the Tech-Tech website before any description is written.

WRONG-BUSINESS MATCH / NAME MISMATCH: the only substantive fetched page is a Kayak listing for 'Anzel's Guest House' at 610 Rubenstein Drive, Pretoria (same street address as this listing, but a different trading name from 'The Angels Place Boutique Hotel'). The amimagazine page had no usable text, and the business's own domain (theangelsplace.co.za) failed to resolve during research. Possible rename, rebrand or lapsed domain; needs manual verification before writing.

Research found no business-specific content: the only pages fetched were generic WhatsApp link-sharing pages (the listing's website is a wa.me link), with no information about the accommodation, the estate unit, or the operator.

Research found no business-specific content: no website pages were fetched for this parcel locker point, and the only search results were generic dictionary and news pages matching the word 'The'. Nothing about this locker service at Copperleaf can be sourced.

Not enough business-specific content: the only page that loaded was a Facebook business page whose content is a single generic blurb ('Construction & maintenance company with years experience in the field. Great team! Great Service!') with no services list, projects or history. The procompare.co.za listing cited in existing_sources was not fetched, so the 1985 founding date and house-extension specialisms in the current description are unverified. The Facebook page also shows "Closed now" (probably just the current hours status, but worth checking whether the business is still trading).
